'''Seth''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Omman Minor]]. Around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], he worked as the [[Chief of Security/Legends|chief of security]] at the planet's primary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="Domino" />
